text:
Maria_support: Heads-up — a customer on Dedicated is hitting 404s when calling our TypeScript SDK client for the models/list route. They reported it after upgrading to @redwood/sdk 1.3.0.

Jon_sdk: Can you paste the error and a minimal repro?

Maria_support: Error log from their app: `Error: Request failed with status code 404` then stack from node showing `client.models.list()` -> sdk/dist/index.js:...

Maria_support: Minimal repro they sent (TS):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.models.list({ model: 'gpt-4o' }); // throws 404
```

Priya_eng: That `models.list` helper was added in the API a while ago, but I think the param name changed to `model_id` on the API side. SDK 1.3.0 still sends `model` in the body.

Jon_sdk: Which backend deploy rolled recently? @DeployBot any rollout to API v2 routes in the last 48h?

DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Canary deploy successful: api-router v2.8.1 -> prod (2026-11-17T03:12:10Z).

Maria_support: Customer said this started right after their infra team rotated keys / updated app and we did the api-router deploy window. They tried reverting to @redwood/sdk 1.2.x and it works.

Jon_sdk: OK that matches a breaking param rename in api-router v2.8.1 where `model` -> `model_id` (we patched to be more explicit). SDK should have compatibility mapping. Could you ask customer to repro with curl so we isolate SDK vs API?

Maria_support: Sent curl repro they tried that works when using `model_id` in body: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/list \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-4o"}'
```
Response 200. With `{"model":"gpt-4o"}` -> 404.

Jon_sdk: Thanks. So two action items: (1) short-term workaround for customers: pin SDK to 1.2.x or call raw HTTP with `model_id`. (2) we need an SDK patch that accepts `model` and rewrites to `model_id` for 1.3.0 users. I'll open a hotfix PR.

Priya_eng: I'll add a compatibility shim on the API side that accepts `model` for another week to buy time, but we should still ship the SDK fix.

Jon_sdk: Filing PR now — will include tests + changelog entry. PR #4572. Patch will be 1.3.1.

Maria_support: Can you add a quick note in the support ticket with the workaround so I can update the customer? They need a repro steps block and the suggested pin command.

Jon_sdk: For support reply: 
- Workaround A: npm i @redwood/sdk@1.2.9
- Workaround B: use direct HTTP body param `model_id` instead of `model` (example curl above)
- ETA for fix: 1.3.1 release within 2 hours, PR #4572.

Maria_support: Perfect, sending now.

Priya_eng: Follow-up: I pushed a quick acceptor on api-router to map legacy `model` -> `model_id` (will expire in 7 days). Once 1.3.1 is out we can remove it.

Jon_sdk: Patch merged, build published to npm as `1.3.1` (dist-tag: latest). Can someone confirm the customer can `npm i @redwood/sdk@1.3.1` and test?

Maria_support: Pinged customer, they confirmed `1.3.1` fixed it for them and no more 404s. Closing ticket after a final verification. :tada:

Jon_sdk: I'll also add a small section to the changelog about param renames and an internal postmortem to avoid undocumented API param changes.

Priya_eng: Thanks everyone. I'll open a short ops note to coordinate future param deprecations.

Maria_support: Closing thread once I update the ticket with PR/patch notes and the short-term pad.

DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Note: api-router compatibility shim scheduled for removal on 2026-11-24.
